newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong sets HK$3.96 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong sets HK$3.96 bln loan.

text.p: Cheung Kong unit Cheung Kong Finance Co's HK$3.96 billion loan facility is in general syndication, bankers said on Monday.
They said the loan has been increased to HK$3.96 billion from HK$3.6 billion in the underwriting phase.
The coordinating arrangers are BA Asia, CIBC CEF, Hang Seng Finance and Societe Generale Asia.

The five-year amortising loan has an average life of four years. Repayment is in five equal semi-annual instalments with a three-year grace period. It pays an interest margin of 45 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.

Fees are 34 basis points for expanded lead managers committing HK$100-125 million, 29 basis points for senior managers committing HK$75-100 million, and 25 basis points for managers committing HK$35-60 million.
Proceeds are to be used for general working capital of the Cheung Kong Group.
